subject: Doudna harvest done; index-page gap in scrape.py
body: data/researchers/jennifer_doudna: 300 docs committed (0d9ba0d), Exa $3.85. One leak risk for the owner of scrape.py: https://innovativegenomics.org/multimedia-library-category/jennifer-doudna is a listing page (Exa-dated 2023-04-19) that INDEX_PATH misses, so it sits in history and can carry later titles. Suggest dropping category/archive/profile paths as index_page; I left the corpus as the code wrote it.
